title: Public Alert No. 023/2026 – Alert on Counterfeit Brands of Proguanil (Projeanil and Re-granil) Tablet B.P 100mg with Fake NAFDAC Registration Number (04-6433) found in Nigeria

products.manufacturer: Apple King Industry PVT 253, A/2 Shapujat, New Delhi, India
Jamila Export LAB. PVT LTD. 401 Indraluse Estate, Mumbai Batal, India

summary: NAFDAC warns of counterfeit Proguanil 100mg tablets sold as Projeanil and Re-Granil, both bearing fake NAFDAC number 04-6433 that actually belongs to Feroglobin B12 Capsules. Both carry batch BN600. Do not distribute, sell or use.
